info.title: OnePlan API
info.description: Backend API for the OnePlan travel planning app

occurredAt.description: ISO8601 client timestamp when event occurred

token.description: RS256 JWT identifying the caller to the wallet provider. Valid for five minutes and useful for nothing else.

identityToken.description: The identity token from Apple or Google

displayName.description: Optional display name (used if creating a new user)

email.description: Optional email (used when Apple doesn't include email after first auth)

nonce.description: Raw nonce for Apple Sign-In replay protection

friendCode.description: Unique friend code for QR sharing

isPro.description: Whether user has active Pro subscription

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is recognised as an admin (server-side check against ADMIN_EMAILS).

engagementPushEnabled.description: Whether engagement push nudges are enabled

engagementConsentGiven.description: Whether the user has given marketing-push consent

engagementPushEnabled.description: Opt out (false) / back in (true) of engagement push nudges

engagementConsent.description: Set true to record explicit marketing-push consent (stamps engagementConsentedAt server-side). Required before any engagement push is sent (App Store 4.5.4).

nonce.description: Raw nonce for Apple Sign-In replay protection

entityId.description: The entity ID (userId for avatar, tripId for cover/photo, expenseId for receipt)

contentType.description: MIME type of the file to upload

uploadUrl.description: The presigned URL to PUT the file to

objectKey.description: The S3 object key (needed for confirm step)
The S3 object key returned from presign

eligible.description: Caller may create/enable web3 trips: server web3 is on and configured, and the request IP is not in a blocked country.

hasWeb3Trip.description: Informational only (UI copy): caller belongs to a web3 trip. Never grants web3 access; only `eligible` does.

available.description: Total scan credits the user can spend right now.

nextProGrantAt.description: ISO 8601 server-time timestamp of the next Pro renewal, when the next billing cycle's scan credits are granted. Null when the user has no active Pro subscription.

adKey.description: Client-generated UUID identifying one completed ad view. Retries with the same key are idempotent.

granted.description: True when the credit was granted (or the same adKey was already granted). False means the daily cap is exhausted.

remainingToday.description: Rewarded-ad grants remaining today (UTC day), max 3.

originalUserId.description: The id the user had before deletion

deletedAt.description: When the user deleted their account (ISO)

purgeAt.description: When this archive is automatically purged (ISO)

daysLeft.description: Days left before the archive is purged

originalUserId.description: The id the user had before deletion

deletedAt.description: When the user deleted their account (ISO)

purgeAt.description: When this archive is automatically purged (ISO)

daysLeft.description: Days left before the archive is purged

snapshot.description: Full snapshot taken at deletion: profile, subscription, auth providers, trips, expenses, listings, scan credits, gifts and an activity summary.

commitHash.description: Server commit hash for the running deployment

decimalPlaces.description: Number of fractional digits normally used for this currency

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null if no more results

currency.description: Trip currency. Defaults to user preferred currency.

localCurrencies.description: Additional local currencies used on the trip. If omitted, a single currency is auto-suggested from the trip country when it differs from the home currency. Up to 5 entries.

isPro.description: Whether user has active Pro subscription

localCurrencies.description: Additional local currencies used on the trip.

web3.description: Trip uses a group wallet (fixed at creation by creator eligibility).

rateStale.description: Present (and true) only on the immediate response of a currency change whose migration used a stale/fallback exchange rate. Never present on reads.

isMember.description: True only when the request is authenticated and that user is an ACCEPTED member of this trip. Always false for the unauthenticated web landing page.

web3.description: The trip uses a group wallet (web3).

web3Eligible.description: The requesting IP may take part in web3 trips. When `web3` is true and this is false, joining answers 403 `web3_unavailable`.

amountVnd.description: Signed VND display amount for spends (member share of amountVnd). Null for deposits/settlements.

subtitle.description: Share chip ("All") or wallet address for deposits

totalBudgetCancelled.description: Total budget amount not yet paid (cancelled)

totalExpenseShare.description: Your total expense share (what you consumed)

netSettlement.description: Net settlement: Budget refund minus expense share

hasVault.description: True when this trip has a group vault (web3 leave rules)

netMicro.description: Signed vault position in micro-USDC (deposit − spend share)

owedMicro.description: micro-USDC the member must deposit before announce (max(0,-net))

lines.description: Vault rows for the leave breakdown (empty for classic trips)

canAnnounce.description: Whether the member may call announce (vault: net>=0 and no pending request)

leaveRequestPending.description: Member already announced; waiting on host confirm

canLeave.description: Whether DELETE member will succeed now (classic leave, or vault cleared legacy)

blockReason.description: owes_group | group_owes_you | leave_pending when vault leave is blocked

vaultLeaveCleared.description: Host has marked this member vault-cleared for leave

netMicro.description: Live signed net micro-USDC (deposit − spend share)

announcedNetMicro.description: READY: latest vault DEPOSIT micro-USDC from history. PAYOUT: credit to send.

walletAddress.description: Member OnePlan wallet (for PAYOUT address check)

payoutPending.description: Set when a vault payout was required (net > 0)

decision.description: Null while this member has not voted yet

needsApproval.description: True while the payment is above the trip limit and no second member has approved it. The money is still in the vault.

recipient.description: The member a settlement paid. Null for anything else: only a settlement moves money back to a person.

amountMicro.description: Amount in micro-USDC as a decimal string

amountVnd.description: Amount in VND as a decimal string, for payments

paidBy.description: Who paid, when a single member did rather than the group

shareWith.description: Empty means the expense is shared by everyone

amountMicro.description: Portion of the cash debt attributed to this line, micro-USDC string. All lines on a debt sum to amountMicro.
Amount in micro-USDC as a decimal string

isConfirmed.description: The creditor has confirmed receiving this

canConfirm.description: True only for the creditor. Nobody else may confirm a debt was paid.

lines.description: Per-expense breakdown that sums to amountMicro (debtor share weights)

toWalletAddress.description: Creditor OnePlan Wallet address when linked — enables Send for the debtor

mySettlement.description: Off-chain pay/receive rows relevant to the caller after vault settlement

currency.description: Trip currency. Changing it converts all existing budgets/expenses to the new currency at current rates. Not allowed on ended trips.

localCurrencies.description: Additional local currencies used on the trip. Can be edited at any time. Up to 5 entries.

userIds.description: Array of user IDs to invite

role.description: CO_HOST or MEMBER. HOST is not assignable: it belongs to whoever created the trip.

totalExpenseShare.description: Your total expense share (what you consumed)

netSettlement.description: Net settlement: Budget refund minus expense share

amount.description: Positive amount with up to 2 decimal places

userIds.description: Contributor member user IDs for GROUP budgets. When omitted the budget is fanned out to every accepted trip member. Not allowed for PERSONAL budgets.

originalAmount.description: Amount the user typed in their original currency. Must be provided together with originalCurrency.

originalCurrency.description: Currency of the original amount. Must be provided together with originalAmount.

originalAmount.description: Amount in the original currency the user typed.

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate used to convert originalAmount → amount (in trip currency).

rateStale.description: Present (and true) only on the immediate response of a create/update that used a stale/fallback exchange rate. Never present on reads.

amount.description: Positive amount with up to 2 decimal places

userIds.description: Contributor member user IDs for GROUP budgets. Updating this list updates budget payment rows.

originalAmount.description: Amount the user typed in their original currency. Must be provided together with originalCurrency.

originalCurrency.description: Currency of the original amount. Must be provided together with originalAmount.

rate.description: Exchange rate: multiply an amount in `from` by this value to get the equivalent amount in `to`.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this rate was last refreshed. Plain string (not `format: date-time`) to match the rest of the API — iOS parses it manually because swift-openapi-generator defaults to a strict `ISO8601DateFormatter` that rejects fractional seconds emitted by Node `Date.toISOString()`.

isStale.description: True when the returned rate is older than 24h, from static fallback, or otherwise unreliable.

locale.description: Device language; persisted to the user so engagement copy is localized.

audience.description: ALL broadcasts to every device; TARGETED uses `recipients`.

destination.description: Screen the push opens on tap. Omit to just open the app.

listingId.description: Marketplace listing the push opens on tap. Only used when destination=MARKET; older app builds without listing routing fall back to the Market tab.

platform.description: Restrict broadcast to a single platform. Omit to send to all platforms.

recipients.description: Required when audience=TARGETED. Each entry is an email or numeric user ID.

recipientDevices.description: Number of device tokens the push was dispatched to.

unknownRecipients.description: Targeted recipients (emails / user IDs) that matched no user. Empty for broadcasts.

messageId.description: Highest chat message ID the current user has seen for this trip

planDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if dayNumber is not provided.

dayNumber.description: Relative day number (1-based). Required if planDate is not provided.

voiceUrl.description: S3 object key for the voice recording

planDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, null during PLANNING when dayNumber is used

dayNumber.description: Relative day number (1-based), set during PLANNING status

voiceUrl.description: S3 object key for the voice recording

imageUrls.description: Image URLs or object keys (max 5). If provided, replaces the entire image list.

userIds.description: If provided, replaces the entire member list.
